description: Documents the specific error scenario of API-069 (Create Sample Collection) where quantity is 0. Same endpoint as API-069, isolated here to preserve the docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx functionality numbering. This is a confirmed DB GAP.

body.quantity: 0 - not a valid collected quantity in this scenario

validation: quantity should be > 0 per the intended API contract

success.status_definition: N/A - this functionality ID documents only the failure path; see API-069 for the success contract

constraints: quantity NUMERIC(10,2) - nullable, no CHECK constraint in the current schema

notes: database/schema/019_sample_collection.sql defines quantity as a plain nullable NUMERIC(10,2) with no CHECK constraint. database/api_contracts_test/016_sample_collection.sql's TEST 5 scenario confirms an insert with quantity = 0 is currently accepted by PostgreSQL, even though the intended API behavior is 400 Bad Request. A CHECK (quantity > 0) constraint (allowing NULL, since quantity is optional) would need to be added to database/schema/019_sample_collection.sql to actually enforce this at the DB layer; until then, quantity validation must happen at the API layer only.
